create_MemMonitor: create a MemMonitor instance to track Linux process memory usage with optional enable/disable
run_MemMonitor_get_memory: run MemMonitor.get_memory() to quickly parse /proc/<pid>/statm and return size, resident, shared, text, lib, data, dt in kB
run_MemMonitor_get_memory_full: run MemMonitor.get_memory_full() to parse /proc/<pid>/status and return detailed memory fields like VmPeak, VmRSS, VmSwap in kB
test_MemMonitor: test MemMonitor to verify it returns -1 on non-Linux platforms and -2 when disabled
review_MemMonitor: review MemMonitor class that provides fast and detailed Linux memory monitoring via /proc pseudo-files
